insight: Adobe's $20B deal to buy Figma collapsed in Dec 2023 over regulators, forcing a $1B breakup fee; Figma IPO'd in 2025.
name: Figma AI
tagline: AI design and prompt-to-code built into Figma.
description: Figma's AI layer for product design: First Draft generates editable layouts from a prompt, content tools fill real copy, and a canvas Design Agent edits via natural language. Figma Make turns prompts into working prototypes, and the Figma MCP server pipes design context into coding tools.

modelSupport.notes: Figma AI features are powered by a mix of third-party foundation models behind Figma's own product surface.

edge: AI lives inside the tool designers already use, then pushes real design context straight into code — no rebuild in a separate app.
cons: AI tied to a Figma subscription
